Isometric low-poly 3D diorama floating as a small rounded island on a plain solid #ebebeb background with a soft contact shadow beneath it. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded toy-model shapes, gentle warm studio lighting, soft long shadows, tilt-shift miniature look. Cohesive color palette of #ff4d1c, #141414, #ebebeb, #0d0d0d, #8a8a8a, #073bc7. Highly detailed, centered composition, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

Subject: A compact ROUND island holding a small valley of easing curves. A single smooth s-shaped bezier slope runs through the middle of the round island, steep at its centre and flattening gently at both ends, lined with small marker posts clustered tightly at the flat ends and spread far apart across the steep middle. Rounded clay trees and a small blue pond sit around the rim. A small rounded clay-toy character: young Korean man, soft bowl-cut dark hair, black turtleneck, calm friendly face, simple dot eyes, no text on clothing. is LARGE and clearly visible, standing near the centre of the frame on the slope, mid-stride at an easy pace, while a shoulder bag swings out behind him, his hair lifts and one hand adjusts his collar — small supporting motions alongside the walk. Everything in the scene looks mid-breath and alive: pennants lifting, lanterns swaying, leaves tilting, nothing perfectly still.
